title: Simulation transition function
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $I$ consist of a verifier state and an optional Boolean value. The simulation transition function maps an address state and a pair of Boolean input symbols to the state obtained by applying one address step using the simulation chunk determined by $N$ and $I$, with its Boolean parameter set first to false and then to true.
